text.p: Bordeaux have signed Brazilian midfielder Ricardinho from Parana on a four-year contract, the club said on Saturday.
The transfer fee for the 21-year-old, whose full name is Ricardo Luiz Pozzi Rodriguez, came to about $2 million, sources close to the French first division club said.
Ricardinho, who signed on Friday, scored 11 goals for his Brazilian club Parana last season, four from free kicks.

"The presence of (Brazilian defender) Paulo Gralak had a lot to do with my transfer to Bordeaux and will help me become acclimatised more easily," Ricardinho said. Gralak joined Bordeaux from Coritiba early last season.
Ricardinho is Bordeaux's eighth recruit for the new season. Others include striker Lilian Laslandes from Auxerre, Dutch goalkeeper Stanley Menzo and Yugoslav defender Nisa Saveljik.
